title: Verifier verdicts
description: runs/<paper-slug>/verify/verdicts.json. Generated by agents/verifier/verify_run.py next to RESULTS.md, from the executed check scripts. The Writer reads it and does not edit it.

paper.description: Paper slug: the run directory name.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 time of the verify_run call.

commit.description: Repo commit the checks ran on, with a note if the tree had uncommitted changes.

claim.description: Equation number from equations.json that this check tests as printed. null for a supporting check (for example a corrected form), which gets no ruling on a paper claim.

verdict.description: The word the script printed, or ERROR when it printed no single VERDICT line.

ruling.description: From agents/verifier/rule.py. null when claim is null.

engine.description: The ENGINE constant declared in the check script.

script.description: Path of the check script, relative to the run directory.

detail.description: The detail text after the verdict, e.g. the counterexample.
